WITH total AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total
  FROM scanfeatures
), shares AS (
  SELECT zoneref, articount,
         articount::numeric / NULLIF(total.artifact_total, 0) AS share
  FROM scanfeatures
  CROSS JOIN total
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL
    AND total.artifact_total IS NOT NULL
), average AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT shares.zoneref, shares.articount, shares.share,
       shares.share - average.average_share AS share_minus_average
FROM shares
CROSS JOIN average
WHERE average.average_share IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
